concept.hr: Diodni prsten kao preklopka polariteta: U₃ = ±U₁ prema predznaku U₂
concept.en: A diode ring as a polarity switch: U₃ = ±U₁, following the sign of U₂

summary.hr: Pravokutni U₂ otvara dvije po dvije nasuprotne diode; tako izlaz U₃ u svakoj poluperiodi dobiva U₁ ili −U₁, tj. umnožak U₁ i U₂.
summary.en: A square-wave U₂ opens two opposite diodes at a time, so each half period the output U₃ gets U₁ or −U₁: the product of U₁ and U₂.

what.hr: Aplet applet_ringmodulator.html (oba sklopna stanja prstenastog modulatora) i njegove slike 1122–1124 (sklop, naponi čvorova i valni oblici), te tekst o prstenastom mješaču (50ohm.de, odjeljak mischer_2)
what.en: The applet applet_ringmodulator.html (both switching states of the ring modulator) and its figures 1122–1124 (the circuit, the node voltages and the waveforms), and the text on the ring mixer (50ohm.de, section mischer_2)

credits.by: 50ohm.de-Autorenteam, AJW-Referat des DARC e.V. (figures: Prof. Dr. Matthias Jung, DL9MJ)

changes.hr: Prilagođen simdeck kitu, slike ponovno nacrtane kao SVG, preveden na engleski, tri gumba postala 12 koraka po poluperiodama napona U₂, dodani nazivi dioda, obojani putovi, očitanja, klizači za Û₁ i f₂ / f₁ i predlošci
changes.en: Adapted to the simdeck kit, the figures redrawn as SVG, translated into English, the three buttons turned into 12 steps of one half period of U₂ each, the diode names, coloured paths, readout, sliders for Û₁ and f₂ / f₁ and presets added
